description.en: Custom firmware mods for the UC Remote 3. Mod 1: configurable charging-screen screensaver with Matrix rain, Starfield, Minimal, Analog, and TV Static themes. Mod 3: compact battery indicator on every entity / activity detail page (v1.4.21 adds a sibling WiFi indicator with a Settings → UI toggle). Mod 4: WiFi UX bundle — live link diagnostics, always-visible signal indicator, reconnect button, WoWLAN toggle on UCR3. Mod 5: Active Session Keeper — resets the device's sleep countdown every 4.5 min via set_power_mode(NORMAL) pings while a media player is actively playing or recent media-control buttons are pressed. Mod 6: Phantom-Wake Suppressor — forces the device back to LOW_POWER if a wake event happens with no user input within a configurable grace window, eliminating WoWLAN-induced phantom-wake battery drain (v1.4.22 fixed the API call format that had silently broken Mod 5/6 since their respective releases; v1.4.23 added recent-input lookback to handle wake-press timing). Wake-replay HUD: post-wake reconnect banner — v1.4.21 made it more prominent (120 px height, font 32, brighter color, subtle pulse). v1.4.33 fixes a 70-second Settings → Power open delay caused by upstream Slider's tick Repeater over-instantiating thousands of invisible Rectangles when slider ranges are large (root cause v1.4.26 missed). v1.4.34: QML test coverage for BatteryStatusChip / WifiStatusChip / ReconnectingHUD overlays — closes the largest contiguous block of zero-coverage custom UI per the audit roadmap (B5). v1.4.35: HUD test fix — `SequentialAnimation on opacity` and `RotationAnimation on rotation` register as property value sources, not children/resources, so they're unreachable via findByObjectName traversal. Replaced with binding-chain test on `hud.active`. Also bundles `images.qrc` into test resources (silences spurious loader_small.png warning). v1.4.36: B1 matrixrain decomposition — largest single-file refactor in the project's history. matrixrain.cpp 1445 → 746 LOC (-48 %) across three architectural phases. New helpers in `src/ui/matrixrain/`: SingleLayerRenderer (Phase A — stateless render path, mirrors LayerPipeline), InputHandler (Phase B — QObject-with-timers, owns enter-button state machine + 2 internal timers, mirrors ActivitySessionKeeper / PhantomWakeSuppressor), BindingHelper (Phase C — all-static, 8 ScreensaverConfig binding helpers, mirrors AtlasBuilder). Five collaborator classes total in `src/ui/matrixrain/`. QML contract preserved verbatim. Each phase independently CI-green and visually verified on UCR3. Also bundled: C1 ScreensaverConfig Battery-deferred-connect cleanup (drops `QTimer::singleShot(500, ...)` retry hack via `main.cpp` construction reorder; `Q_ASSERT(batt && ...)` regression net), STYLE_GUIDE §1.4 AP-UC-13 extension on Repeater `model:` gating (cheap-hygiene combo with `visible:`), 3× description text consistency sweep (`colors.medium` → `colors.light`). v1.4.37: audit-driven hygiene cleanup (path to A−). Doc/test only — zero binary changes; install bundle ships byte-identical binary to v1.4.36 with an updated release.json. Closes 4 audit findings: 9 `verify(true, "...")` fake smoke tests in integration suites replaced with observable post-state assertions (SignalSpy patterns, +10 net real assertions); BUILD.md drops a previous developer's macOS user path and adds Windows + Git-Bash Docker invocation; STYLE_GUIDE §1.11 documents auto-revert as a crash safety net (NOT a validation review — uses the v1.4.22 setPowerMode silent failure as case study); A11Y_AUDIT.md gets its first audit pass (static analysis only — page existence, KeyNavigation chain counts, font sizing sweep, touch-target dimension check; manual on-device items explicitly deferred to v1.4.38). v1.4.38: test-only CI fix for v1.4.37 — the N4 rewrite encoded a wrong assumption about InputHandler architecture (`interactiveInput()` is the imperative-dispatch path that doesn't go through the `enterAction` signal). Binary identical to v1.4.37; release exists solely to attach a green CI run to the latest tag. v1.4.39: Mod 5 v2 — Active Session Keeper now uses the firmware's native `POST /system/power/standby_inhibitors` REST API instead of 270-second WS `setPowerMode(NORMAL)` pings. Eliminates the race window where session activity stopping just before a ping cycle could let the firmware's standby_timeout_sec expire. Event-based contract: create a BLOCK inhibitor on session activate, DELETE it on session deactivate. Bonus side-effect: BLOCK inhibitor keeps the device solidly in NORMAL during active sessions, so the LOW_POWER ↔ NORMAL transitions that trigger phantom-wake events can't fire — Mod 6 still owns idle-period phantom-wake suppression but has nothing to do during active sessions. Authenticated via `Authorization: Bearer` over UC_TOKEN content (Phase 0 probe established this is the firmware's canonical auth path for the local REST API). Default ON since this is the firmware's native path (the prior WS ping loop was a workaround for an endpoint that already existed); fall back via Settings → Power → Use REST inhibitor API toggle if a future firmware OTA breaks it. End-to-end verified on UCR3 firmware 2.9.1 across 6 lifecycle smokes: activate, cleanup, orphan recovery on UI restart, mid-session toggle flip, PIN unchanged, no auto-revert. v1.4.40: Audio restored under firmware 2.9.2 + new Settings → Sound → Dock chime picker with 6 variants (Warp / Ascend / Bell / Chord / Pulse / Zap, tap to preview and select). Diagnostic confirmed firmware 2.9.2 dropped the env var that custom-ui used to locate the stock UC sound files — every play() call no-opped against null pointers, killing all UI feedback (clicks, confirms, errors) and the dock chime. Fix: bundle 4 UI sound effects + 5 alternate chimes (CC0, generated via tools/gen_sounds.py — peak-normalized to 0 dBFS with mastering-style soft-clip pre-gain for max audibility on UCR3's small speaker) directly in deploy/config/, add a UC_SOUND_EFFECTS_PATH empty-fallback in uiController.cpp that resolves to $UC_CONFIG_HOME (same dir our font and screensaver json already use). Sounds are 16-bit PCM stereo at 44.1 kHz — mono produces snd_pcm_hw_params_set_channels: err = -22 (EINVAL) from UCR3's ALSA backend. Diagnostic instrumentation in soundEffects.cpp (qCWarning(lcCore)) retained as future-regression detector — visible at boot via /api/system/logs?s=custom-ui&q=Default+audio. Forward-compatible: env wins if non-empty, so a future firmware that restores UC_SOUND_EFFECTS_PATH transparently uses stock sounds for variant 1 (zap_future.wav). v1.4.41: 3 polish fixes on top of v1.4.40. (1) Dock chime no longer chops up at docking — the heavyweight ChargingScreen.qml async load was contending with the ALSA audio thread on UCR3's quad-core ARM, producing audible buffer underruns mid-playback. main.qml now plays the chime FIRST, then defers screensaver activation by 350 ms via dockChimeGraceTimer (covers all 6 chime durations except Bell's tail which is exponentially-decayed by then). (2) Screensaver no longer becomes unclearable when the device boots while docked. main.qml's onPowerSupplyChanged handler now distinguishes the firmware's initial battery state pump (boot-while-docked, fires within the first 3 s of QML load before InputController / ButtonNavigation / Popup parenting are fully wired — opening the screensaver here left it undismissible because tap and key handlers couldn't capture input) from a real user-initiated dock event. Boot-while-docked uses a 2 s activation delay (gives QML/input subsystems time to settle) and skips the audio chime since this isn't a real dock event. Normal runtime dock events unchanged (350 ms grace + chime). (3) Settings → Sound → Dock chime description text bumped from 18 pt / colors.medium to 22 pt / colors.light — matches the v1.4.36 description-text consistency sweep. Loudness tuning: write_wav() pre_gain 1.5 → 1.2, soft_drive 3.0 → 2.2 — earlier brick-wall settings produced harmonic distortion on long chime tails (Bell's overtone stack got squashed flat against the limiter ceiling); 2.2 keeps the tails breathing while staying ~6-8 dB louder than the original synthesis. No new functional surface area — these are all UX polish on existing v1.4.40 work. End-to-end verified on UCR3 firmware 2.9.2.
